## Activity

During June 2025, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 100 captures. Capture activity was maintained across the reporting period, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded total provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures set out below. No additional activity measure is included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 100 captures, 7 were ungradable. This gives an ungradable rate of 7.0. The result indicates that image quality affected a limited proportion of recorded activity, while the remaining captures were available for grading. The ungradable total should continue to be monitored through routine operational review, with attention to consistent image acquisition and session delivery.

## Grading

Grading identified 18 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This shows that the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading remained short during June 2025. The referable findings and grading lag should be considered together when reviewing service performance. Overall, the report records activity, image quality and grading outcomes for Hill Counties Health Centre.
